description: Create or fully replace a screen from augmented HTML (html_aug; grammar in the server instructions) with one root element. title: required to create a screen, rejected for a component/pattern. kind:"component"|"pattern" writes a design-system definition instead, named by screen: a default-variant root plus optional sibling <template data-variant="x"> blocks, each the complete variant. In a definition, never style the data-slot element itself — an instance discards that style; style a wrapper.
name: write_html
